Class SmartVelocityMechanism

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.velocity.SmartVelocityMechanism
Direct Known Subclasses:
FlyWheel
public abstract class SmartVelocityMechanism extends SmartMechanism
Abstract intermediate base class for all closed-loop velocity mechanisms in YAMS.

Sits between SmartMechanism and concrete velocity mechanisms such as FlyWheel. Provides velocity setpoint management (SmartMechanism.setMechanismVelocitySetpoint(AngularVelocity) and SmartMechanism.setMeasurementVelocitySetpoint(LinearVelocity)) and a 2D visualization model that subclasses populate and update.

Command and Trigger factories live on the corresponding yams.commands2.mechanisms subclass, not here. Velocity mechanisms have no max()/min() concept.

For Subclass Authors

Every concrete subclass must implement these abstract methods inherited from SmartMechanism:

  • SmartMechanism.getRelativeMechanismPosition()
  • SmartMechanism.visualizationUpdate()
  • SmartMechanism.getName()
  • SmartMechanism.simIterate()
  • SmartMechanism.updateTelemetry()
